domain: entire exact four-state boundary-Ising exponential-family closure; compact coordinates r=1/X,s=1/Y,t=1/Z in [0,1]^3
quantifiers: For every physical boundary-Ising probability distribution generated by nonnegative J3,J4,J5, including all parameter-infinite closure points, and for the accepted strict spectral tuple.
proof_type: exact algebra + rational interval Bernstein cover + independent checker
conclusion: Globally on the exact boundary-Ising closure, lambda_2(Cov)<=sigma_*. Equality occurs only at the exact R7P-045 double-root family point with J4=J5=0, J3>0 within the boundary model. limitations: No theorem for finite J6 off this parity boundary.
